brief:
Mohammed Radwan, a camera repairman in Gaza, has become essential to journalists documenting the conflict, Al Jazeera English reported. As equipment sustains damage across the territory, Radwan repairs and maintains cameras that would otherwise fall out of service, enabling news crews to continue their work.

Journalists in Gaza depend on functioning equipment to document events. Radwan's technical skills allow media workers to keep reporting despite the challenges of operating in the conflict zone.
dek: As journalists in Gaza continue documenting the war, camera repairman Mohammed Radwan keeps damaged equipment in use.
title: Gaza repairman keeps journalists' cameras running amid conflict
